_about: Account B's Riftgate Nameplate rows (collection candidates, https://claude.ai/artifact/6K6mq49XHCUbdZnkzp5rra), exported 29 September 2026 because B cannot read or write A's db. An account-A session writes into A's nameplate every row missing there or differing in status or concept (ArtifactData batch), keeping A's side where A is newer (Gelada rejected), then deletes this file and a B session deletes B's page.

adrestia.concept: Greek: she who cannot be escaped, just retribution, Nemesis's companion. Greek again though.
adrestia.name: Adrestia

alecto.concept: The Fury of unceasing anger, with Tisiphone (avenger of murder) and Megaera beside her. Greek again.
alecto.name: Alecto

anglerfish.concept: The lure. A frame that taunts or draws fire.
anglerfish.name: Anglerfish

ankylosaur.concept: The one dinosaur that reads as a tank, not a toy: club tail as the fixed melee, plates everywhere.
ankylosaur.name: Ankylosaur

aurochs.concept: Ryan's pick over Mammoth (which is also a Heavy Gear strider). Horns as rams: the Wild Boar's bigger sibling, or the heavy plantigrade biped.
aurochs.name: Aurochs

bighorn.concept: The ram. A quad that charges.
bighorn.name: Bighorn

burro.concept: Small, stubborn, carries too much. A wheeled ammo carrier or support car.
burro.name: Burro

camel_spider.concept: The desert horror of soldiers' stories. A fast wheeled thing with too many guns forward.
camel_spider.name: Camel Spider

cane_toad.concept: Poisonous, invasive, everywhere. A cheap wheeled support car with a toxic payload. Funny in the Dodo way.
cane_toad.name: Cane Toad

colobus.concept: Black and white, no thumbs. An elegant light frame.
colobus.name: Colobus

cuttlefish.concept: Adaptive camouflage and a beak. The Dingo owns the camo passive today, so this needs another idea.
cuttlefish.name: Cuttlefish

drill.concept: The mandrill's cousin (Mandrillus leucophaeus): same face, same build. The word is a tool too. Claude's rename for the Mandrill.
drill.name: Drill

dunkleosteus.concept: Armoured jaw, no teeth, shears. Could be Minerva's heavy flyer: a battlecruiser with a bite. Or it goes to Aphelion as a sea creature.
dunkleosteus.name: Dunkleosteus

enma.concept: Japanese judge of the dead (Yama). Pairs with Ammit as a weigher of souls from another culture.
enma.name: Enma

forseti.concept: Norse god of justice and reconciliation, the one Norse figure with no axe.
forseti.name: Forseti

frigatebird.concept: Huge wings, steals other birds' catches. An interceptor that strips shield or heat off its target.
frigatebird.name: Frigatebird

gelada.concept: Grass-eating baboon with a red chest patch. A heavy support biped, already in Aphelion white and red.
gelada.name: Gelada

gibbon.concept: Long arms, swings. A light hover-biped or a variable-geometry frame.
gibbon.name: Gibbon

hippo.concept: Fat, fast in a straight line, murderous. A heavy wheeled breacher.
hippo.name: Hippo

hobby.concept: The small fast falcon that catches swifts on the wing. A lighter Sparrowhawk; the name reads as a pilots' joke.
hobby.name: Hobby

horned_lizard.concept: Squirts blood from its eyes when grabbed: the retaliate passive on a squat quad.
horned_lizard.name: Horned Lizard

hoverfly.concept: A hover platform that is literally a hoverfly. Red stripes on white.
hoverfly.name: Hoverfly

hubris.concept: From the sins vein, unfleshed. The Council's own house naming a weapon for the sin that ends kings.
hubris.name: Hubris

kelpie.concept: Australian herding dog; a fast wheeled harasser that works the flank. Also a Scottish water spirit, which is a wrinkle against the myth rule.
kelpie.name: Kelpie

kite.concept: Plain Kite is free (BattleTech has Blood Kite). Hangs in the wind: a loitering gunship.
kite.name: Kite

kittum.concept: Mesopotamian truth and justice, Shamash's daughter. Obscure enough to fail the picture test in its own way.
kittum.name: Kittum

mantis_shrimp.concept: The fastest punch in the sea. A strike frame with one big hit. Shares a word with the Mantis (BattleTech, Halo), which the check will show.
mantis_shrimp.name: Mantis Shrimp

muskox.concept: Ryan gives this to W&S before Minerva. Shaggy heavy quad that forms a ring: a defensive line walker.
muskox.name: Muskox

mustang.clash: Mustang is a Heavy Gear machine
mustang.concept: The obvious frontier horse, and Heavy Gear's Peace River already has one. Rejected as an example of the check working.
mustang.name: Mustang

nautilus.concept: Spiral shell, jet propulsion. A hover platform with a shield spiral.
nautilus.name: Nautilus

nightjar.concept: Camouflaged, crepuscular, silent. A stealth flyer, which sits oddly with Kestrel's chrome; maybe the point.
nightjar.name: Nightjar

onryo.concept: Japanese vengeful spirit. Ryan's, to look at next. Fits vengeance exactly and opens a third culture.
onryo.name: Onryo

pangolin.concept: Armour that rolls: a tracked hull whose plates close into a shield stance. The shield-heavy Minerva.
pangolin.name: Pangolin

parts_antimatter_edges.concept: Arsenal. Melee execute without the devour: the plain version of the talons for a later machine.
parts_antimatter_edges.name: Antimatter Edges

parts_blazethrower.concept: Arsenal's starter burn: energy line 20 with burn, 10 heat.
parts_blazethrower.name: Blazethrower

parts_chemical_bomb.concept: W&S. The carrier for the planned corrode keyword (percent damage over time). Wants a better name: Caustic Shells?
parts_chemical_bomb.name: Chemical Bomb

parts_combustion_field.concept: Arsenal. Equipment: every foe in the front rank gains a burn stack. Area burn without a roll.
parts_combustion_field.name: Combustion Field

parts_debris_integrator.concept: Minerva. Gains shield on a kill: the wreck becomes plating. Wants an on-kill hook, same as devour.
parts_debris_integrator.name: Debris Integrator

parts_density_press.concept: Minerva. One enormous melee crush, kinetic with a wide roll, the biggest single hit the treads carry.
parts_density_press.name: Density Press

parts_disassembly_line.concept: Minerva. An industrial penetrate: a line that takes the column apart, front then back.
parts_disassembly_line.name: Disassembly Line

parts_entanglement_tether.concept: Aphelion. The damage-redirection family Ryan wants: swap targeting with an ally, or pull a blow aimed at an ally onto yourself. Equipment, ally-targeted.
parts_entanglement_tether.name: Entanglement Tether

parts_entropy_condenser.concept: Arsenal's starter vent (30), and the Nemesis's relief valve.
parts_entropy_condenser.name: Entropy Condenser

parts_feedback_probe.concept: Aphelion. A debuff: the foe's next blow also hurts itself. Retaliation moved onto the enemy.
parts_feedback_probe.name: Feedback Probe

parts_flakshot_repeater.concept: W&S. The Prairie Dog's locked gun: line kinetic 10 to 30 with rapid, so its round is shoot, roll again, shoot, leave.
parts_flakshot_repeater.name: Flakshot Repeater

parts_fragmentation_probe.concept: W&S or Aphelion. Indirect with cleave: it bursts in the rank it lands in.
parts_fragmentation_probe.name: Fragmentation Probe

parts_fusion_assimilator.concept: Arsenal. A vent that turns the heat it sheds into shield. Sanctified name, sinister effect.
parts_fusion_assimilator.name: Fusion Assimilator

parts_gatling_rockets.concept: W&S. Indirect, three strikes of small numbers. Storm Rockets is the Kestrel air-to-ground twin.
parts_gatling_rockets.name: Gatling Rockets

parts_gigawatt_thunderspear.concept: Kestrel. A penetrating energy lance at absurd heat: the Lance's over-tuned cousin. The name is the whole pitch.
parts_gigawatt_thunderspear.name: Gigawatt Thunderspear

parts_gravity_knuckles.concept: Arsenal. The Nemesis's locked fists: energy melee 30 with burn and volatile, so every punch feeds the Crucible.
parts_gravity_knuckles.name: Gravity Knuckles

parts_hardlight_projector.concept: Aphelion. A shield cast on an ally that interposes: the next blow aimed at them is taken by the projector's owner. The other half of the redirection family.
parts_hardlight_projector.name: Hardlight Projector

parts_ion_resonator.concept: Kestrel. Energy line that disables the showing entry of the target, the player's side of the foes' disable keyword.
parts_ion_resonator.name: Ion Resonator

parts_juggernaut_drive.concept: Passive, the Wild Boar: overwhelm on every attack, damage past a kill spills into the rank behind.
parts_juggernaut_drive.name: Juggernaut Drive

parts_laser_carbine.concept: Kestrel's starter gun: energy line 20, 5 heat.
parts_laser_carbine.name: Laser Carbine

parts_mag_field_projector.concept: Kestrel or Aphelion. The carrier for the planned energy_armour status: blows on shield reduced by a flat amount until end of round.
parts_mag_field_projector.name: Mag-field Projector

parts_matter_recombinator.concept: Aphelion. If hull repair ever exists, this is its one carrier. Parked: shield recharge is the regen mechanic for now.
parts_matter_recombinator.name: Matter Recombinator

parts_maxigun.concept: Minerva. A rotary cannon that strikes three times for small numbers. The horde gun.
parts_maxigun.name: Maxigun

parts_meathook.concept: W&S or Minerva. Melee that drags a back-rank foe into the front rank. A new verb: rank manipulation.
parts_meathook.name: Meathook

parts_megataser_harpoon.concept: W&S. The Dingo's locked pin: line kinetic 10 to 20 with suppress at 10 heat.
parts_megataser_harpoon.name: Megataser Harpoon

parts_meteor_artillery.concept: Arsenal's advanced piece on the Nemesis: energy indirect 30 with burn, 15 heat.
parts_meteor_artillery.name: Meteor Artillery

parts_nanobot_swarm.concept: Aphelion. A corrode carrier in the astronomical register, if corrode lands.
parts_nanobot_swarm.name: Nanobot Swarm

parts_neutrino_rifle.concept: Aphelion. Energy penetrate: it does not notice the front rank is there.
parts_neutrino_rifle.name: Neutrino Rifle

parts_paradox_generator.concept: Aphelion. The Mandrill's codex device: a suppress that lands on the target's next action as well. A locked candidate for the Mandrill.
parts_paradox_generator.name: Paradox Generator

parts_phase_shift_drive.concept: Aphelion. The carrier for the planned Phased status: cannot attack, cannot be hit, until end of round. A withdraw without leaving.
parts_phase_shift_drive.name: Phase-shift Drive

parts_quintessence_tap.concept: Passive, the Ammit: Overcharged never decays and lasts the battle. Sanctified on its face, sinister on reflection, which is the Arsenal naming rule.
parts_quintessence_tap.name: Quintessence Tap

parts_rocket_punch.concept: Minerva. A melee blow with indirect reach: the fist leaves. Silly on purpose.
parts_rocket_punch.name: Rocket Punch

parts_sawed_off_flaregun.concept: W&S. A cheap line burn for the cars: small numbers, one stack, 0 heat.
parts_sawed_off_flaregun.name: Sawed-off Flaregun

parts_scraptapult.concept: W&S. The cheapest indirect there is: a huge kinetic roll, 0 heat, no keywords. Everything works.
parts_scraptapult.name: Scraptapult

parts_singularity_cannon.concept: Aphelion. The biggest single energy hit in the game and the heat to match. Quark Imploder and Underspace Imploder folded into this.
parts_singularity_cannon.name: Singularity Cannon

parts_sonic_ballista.concept: W&S. A line suppress, the direct-fire cousin of the Shock Barrage.
parts_sonic_ballista.name: Sonic Ballista

parts_soulcutter_talons.concept: Arsenal. The Ammit's four locked claws: energy melee 20 with execute and devour.
parts_soulcutter_talons.name: Soulcutter Talons

parts_storm_rockets.concept: Kestrel. Under-wing pods: line, multiple strikes, some heat. The Goshawk's natural second weapon.
parts_storm_rockets.name: Storm Rockets

parts_subspace_solenoid.concept: Passive, the Mandrill: +50% damage to a foe carrying any status.
parts_subspace_solenoid.name: Subspace Solenoid

parts_tactical_databank.concept: Passive, the Dingo: with an ally in the fight its kinetic weapons roll their maximum.
parts_tactical_databank.name: Tactical Databank

parts_tesla_gauntlets.concept: Minerva. Melee that Shocks the target, the Armadillo's status on a weapon. Electro-flail folded into this.
parts_tesla_gauntlets.name: Tesla Gauntlets

parts_zero_point_reactor.concept: Arsenal or Aphelion. A passive name more than a component: cooling that rises with Overheating stacks, or heat that never burns hull.
parts_zero_point_reactor.name: Zero-point Reactor

percheron.concept: The Clydesdale's French cousin; a second heavy quad or an artillery tractor.
percheron.name: Percheron

poena.concept: Roman spirit of punishment. The word is also pain.
poena.name: Poena

pronghorn.concept: The fastest quad on the plains. W&S's scout walker.
pronghorn.name: Pronghorn

puffin.concept: The hovercraft Kestrel thought was very cool and the pilots named for a stubby seabird. Comic, loved, sells the maker.
puffin.name: Puffin

saker.clash: Saker is a Heavy Gear machine
saker.concept: The falconer's big desert falcon; a mid-size strike jet. Heavy Gear's Utopia has a Saker hover vehicle, obscure.
saker.name: Saker

shamash.concept: Mesopotamian sun god who handed Hammurabi the law. A large aircraft as a sun.
shamash.name: Shamash

siamang.concept: Loud gibbon with a throat sac. A buff or suppress frame.
siamang.name: Siamang

smilodon.concept: Over Sabre-toothed Tiger. A big cat built Minerva-heavy: short legs, huge forequarters. Digitigrade, so check the flimsy rule.
smilodon.name: Smilodon

swift.concept: Never lands. Kestrel's whole brief in one bird; a fast hover-skimmer.
swift.name: Swift

tern.concept: Small, sharp, dives. A light hover-bomber.
tern.name: Tern

thorny_devil.concept: Spiked, slow, drinks through its skin. A spiky defensive quad.
thorny_devil.name: Thorny Devil

varuna.concept: Vedic keeper of cosmic law who catches liars in his noose. Judgment without war; a new culture.
varuna.name: Varuna

vinegaroon.concept: Whip scorpion that sprays acid. An artillery walker with a long tail mortar; a frontier threat that is not generic.
vinegaroon.name: Vinegaroon

wombat.concept: Squat digger with a bony backside; a tank that backs into the enemy. Halo has a Wombat drone, an obscure one.
wombat.name: Wombat
